findings.detail: The reused DEFERRED_TO_TOP/EXTERNAL_ONLY constraint baseline is not applicable to the exact v1.10 RTL. Its dependency manifest still binds finalized v1.9 design SHA256 010556a5..., ADC_RXD SHA256 0f465fda..., and the retired RXD_WAIT_SOMF/RXD_SKIP_PREFIX/RXD_PAYLOAD structural anchor at lines 4, 11 and 31. The reviewed baseline instead contains design SHA256 afd18901..., ADC_RXD SHA256 416855df..., RXD_IDLE/RXD_PREF/RXD_PAYL and a different sequential-owner split. XDC_Schema.md and release-and-resume.md allow constraint reuse only when the dependency manifest and every structural RTL anchor/hash remain unchanged. The current constraint review therefore requires a fresh v1.10 applicability audit and updated deterministic dependency manifest before a release sidecar can be accepted.

The frozen v1.10 acceptance item ADC_TOP_Design.md:906 requires a directed rxd_three_state test covering IDLE->PREF, PREF miss/hit, PAYL non-complete/complete, one-cycle upk_vld loss and fifo_clr in each state, and forced illegal-state recovery with the three sequential owner blocks checked. The reused v1.9 manifest maps only unpack_schedule_v19_legal_matrix and contains no rxd_three_state case; test_ADC_TOP.py contains no rxd_fsm reference or Force/Deposit operation, and the JUnit has no such testcase. Existing public packet tests non-vacuously prove normal scheduler/data behavior and several recovery paths, but they do not prove all explicitly required state-local clear cases or illegal-state recovery. A contract-bound testcase and fresh VMware evidence are required.

residual_risks: The exact release sidecar independently verifies with 27 components and fingerprint 5b8106185415f67a631c5f51e2a0fa82ad4f8b90c26352c42f8b4f9d079ae5a8, and role separation is valid. Deterministic hash consistency does not waive the stale constraint anchor or missing acceptance evidence.

Static review of ADC_RXD SHA256 416855dfa9c7abfe3482e32597531e2a68a41f54572255521e3edb540502d4a8 found the user's RXD_IDLE/RXD_PREF/RXD_PAYL, dec_fra, upk_trig and pref_fra/pref_del/pref_num names preserved; repaired declarations and widths are consistent; combinational scheduler formulas remain ternary assigns; prefix_beat_r and word_pos_r have distinct single-target owners; next_term_r/term_phase_r have one coupled two-target owner; reset, rxd_clr, PREF hit, PAYL progression and default illegal-state clearing are structurally cycle-equivalent to the finalized design. No latch, multiple-driver, encoded-state CDC, forbidden generate/function or owned-RTL syntax blocker was found.

The fresh run ADC_TOP_2b43a31908ac4c55a6f06be923c38874 is internally coherent at VIF 65333f09d939430e679df93eae9480f75ff54a29e038bcbc6cbeb91d0e2618bc with lint/simulation 0/0 and 15/15 non-skipped PASS. It retains complete packet scoreboards, scheduler representatives, fixed pure prefix, DDC/FIFO recovery, reset and AXI/AXIS backpressure evidence, but cannot close the missing v1.10 directed state test.

The ADI modified-third-party provenance and hash-matched eight-file PUB FWFT/CDC boundary remain intact; source ownership reports PASS. validate_rtl_style.py returns the expected RTL_STYLE_DELTA_REVIEW_REQUIRED for MODIFIED_THIRD_PARTY_RTL, and manual owned-RTL review found no new style blocker.

The three-target finalization patch matches the reviewed draft hashes and simulates mechanically with no REVIEW_PENDING or accepting-review placeholders, but it must not be finalized while findings remain. PPA remains HYPOTHESIS and MODEL_EQUIVALENCE remains NON_VENDOR_EQUIVALENT; VCS/Verdi, Vivado resolution/XSIM, synthesis, implementation, timing closure, bitstream and board validation remain NOT_RUN.
